newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kinkel says concerned over situation in Albania.
newsitem.headline: Kinkel says concerned over situation in Albania.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel said on Tuesday he was "extremely concerned" about the situation in Albania and restrictions on the foreign media based there, a ministry statement said.

It also said Kinkel had asked the current chairman of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE), Danish Foreign Minister Niels Helveg Petersen, to send an OSCE delegation to Albania as a matter of urgency. "Kinkel expressed his extreme concern about the further escalation in the situation in Albania. Attacks on the domestic and foreign media...were not acceptable," the statement said, adding that the German ambassador in Tirana had protested about curbs on the media to the Albanian Foreign Ministry.

The statement said Kinkel had sent a message to his Albanian counterpart calling on him to agree to let an OSCE delegation visit the country, to guarantee press freedom and to ensure the safety of the 168 Germans currently in Albania.
"Albania was for many decades cut off from the rest of the world and is now in an extremely difficult political and economic situation," the statement said.
